name: Little Girl
source:
[spoiler]A 7th floor patient [url=https://vndb.org/c941]Himeko[/url] was charged with back when she was still a volunteer helper at the hospice. This girl was a hallmark of purity and innocence and Himeko used to be very attached to her. She sadly died at her age of just 8.[/spoiler]
